purpose: Test one coefficient-free queue-scope correction: retain V110's node-clearance objective but include the remaining CPU work of every already-admitted resident task, including tasks temporarily blocked by cold start, DAG parents, or data transfer.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v110_only_failure: Spike throughput missed noninferiority by 0.0772% even though two of three seed deltas were nonnegative; every V110 QPR gate and both other throughput gates passed.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v112_falsification: Replacing node-clearance work with the exact no-future-arrival completion work of the current processor-sharing job reduced throughput in all three scenarios and reduced spike and pulse QPR.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.queue_scope_gap: V110 sums assigned-but-not-resident pending work and currently runnable resident work, but excludes resident tasks temporarily blocked by cold start, unfinished parents, or data transfer even though their CPU work is already admitted to the node and will compete once its gate opens.

revealed_v110_mechanism_evidence.definition: sum of queue_parent_blocked_total + queue_data_blocked_total + queue_starting_resident_total; used only to establish that the omitted current-state cohort is material, never as a fitted threshold or scenario switch

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Queue membership in a coefficient-free total admitted-work clearance certificate; no weight, threshold, horizon, service ratio, scenario label, or result-derived margin is introduced.

frozen_parent_profiles.temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V113 fixes 50
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V113 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V113 fixes 3/2
closed_axes.processor_sharing_completion_work: falsified as a universal substitute by V112

hypothesis.primary: A clearance objective is better aligned with workflow throughput than single-job completion work, but it must include all CPU work already admitted to the node rather than only the currently runnable subset.
hypothesis.candidate: Use pending immutable CPU plus the current left_calc of every resident task regardless of its current cold-start/parent/data gate, plus same-window projected immutable CPU and the current player's immutable CPU, divided by node capacity; retain every V110/V109 non-work certificate unchanged.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E908-E910 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V109 first-seen request history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the immutable raw CPU of every assigned-but-not-resident pending task
the current finite nonnegative RunningTask.left_calc of every task already resident in a node container, regardless of its current cold-start, parent, or data gate
the immutable raw CPU of functions already assigned in the current deterministic scheduling window and of the current player
every immutable and current-state V110 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
E899-E907 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap multiplier, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.admitted_work_definition: For a candidate node, sum Func.cpu once for every assigned-but-not-resident pending task, RunningTask.left_calc once for every task in every resident container regardless of readiness, Func.cpu once for every other player already assigned to the node in the current AssignmentState, and the current player's Func.cpu exactly once. Iterate function and request identifiers in stable order and accumulate in f64.
information_boundary.anchor_service_proxy: The identical formula evaluated on the frozen anchor node and the same pre-current-player AssignmentState.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any missing task/function, non-finite or negative left_calc/CPU work, invalid current-player work/capacity/bandwidth, incomplete parent placement, count mismatch, or arithmetic overflow makes the proxy unavailable and preserves the anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: V110's currently runnable resident work cohort expands to every already-admitted resident task, using each task's current remaining CPU work; every non-work input and gate is unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V110: tied maximum remaining-critical-path frontier players only, exact noncritical V94 anchor, 9/10 individual proxy, warm/parent/child locality and CPU/memory headroom noninferiority, routed-score noninferiority, strictly lower complete critical proxy, nonworse routed/OCS/immutable-baseline welfare, and V94 coordination guards.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, a complete admitted-work snapshot, or a certified critical substitution, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V110 causal-arrival and critical-service fields
pending immutable CPU values, all-resident remaining CPU values, count completeness, and unavailable-input counters
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V113 profile
